About these 38 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Wednesday has the most, with 10. The earliest start is Laurel Hill Fridays at 6:45 am; the latest is Wednesday Night Rides at 7:00 pm. After work, 21 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 16 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 7. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders, 6 for women, trans and femme riders and 2 for BIPOC riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
